title: The tangent projection y ↦ P_y is continuous on a Simon submanifold
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, r ∈ ℕ∞ and M ⊆ ℝᴺ with IsSimonSubmanifold (E := ℝⁿ) r M. That is, 1 ≤ r, and every y ∈ M lies in W for some local representation (V, W, ψ) as in Simon 4.1, i.e. IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ. Then the map y ↦ tangentProjection M y ∈ L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ), the orthogonal projection of ℝᴺ onto tangentSpace M y, is continuous on M. Here M carries the relative topology and L(ℝᴺ, ℝᴺ) the operator-norm topology.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M
